scan_interval.description: How often (in seconds) the daemon scans the system for new processes and updates its database.

max_processes.description: Maximum number of processes the daemon will track simultaneously. Larger values increase memory usage.

profile_dir.description: Directory where preload stores readahead profiles for known files and applications.

history_dir.description: Directory where preload stores access history (patterns of file reads) for learning.

proactive.description: Whether to proactively load files for frequently-used processes *before* they are opened (improves responsiveness, but may increase disk usage).

passive.description: Whether to reactively read ahead *only* when a process actually opens a file.

readahead_pages.description: Maximum number of pages to read ahead per I/O request. Set to 0 to use the kernel's default value.

monitor_files.description: Additional files (e.g., libraries, executables) to monitor for access patterns, even if not tracked by PID. Each entry can be a path or glob pattern.

items.description: File path or glob pattern to monitor (e.g., '/usr/lib/*.so*').
